release_rule: Ronin Public v1 remains incomplete while any mandatory capability family lacks an end-to-end supported path.

capabilities.summary: Durable Job/Run/Attempt lifecycle, local/container execution, leases, heartbeat, fencing, reclaim, resume, cancellation, evidence and project-scoped HTTP/CLI/SDK foundation.

Workspace/project persistence, project manifests, Git identity, environments/deployment bindings and PostgreSQL core metadata adapter exist; complete Public v1 APIs/UI, source-control lifecycle and membership administration remain incomplete.

Governed local CSV/JSONL foundations plus executable bounded HTTP JSON and PostgreSQL discovery/read connectors exist; incremental cursor/CDC, writes, JDBC/object-store breadth and public surfaces remain incomplete.

Parquet read/write/inspection, governed Parquet catalog integration, DuckDB reference SQL and optional Delta Lake/Iceberg adapters exist; lifecycle evolution, remote credential wiring, cross-engine interoperability and server APIs remain incomplete.
Notebook/pipeline execution foundations exist; notebook/SQL/pipeline CRUD APIs and Web Studio authoring surfaces remain incomplete.

Durable workflow snapshots/task runs, fenced attempts/retries/dependencies, deterministic task-to-Job planning, execution outbox/reconciliation, deployment-aware controller, cron/events, cancellation/timeouts, bounded backfill, pools, leader fencing and daemon orchestration exist; branching/notifications, broad operator execution, public APIs/UI, deployment wiring and PostgreSQL HA qualification remain incomplete.

Governed assets/revisions and declared/observed lineage persistence plus selected-subgraph Bundle export/planning/atomic import exist; search/glossary/classification/OpenLineage and complete asset-family integration remain incomplete.
Ontology object/property/link/action schemas and persistence exist; instance resolution, KG querying/materialization and governed action execution remain incomplete.
No current supported RQL parser/planner/execution/provider path.

Durable contracts/results plus built-in null/unique/range/domain/row-count/freshness evaluation and optional blocking gate exist; referential/custom execution, scheduler/alert integration and public surfaces remain incomplete.

Experiment/run/model provenance plus executable deterministic tabular classification/regression training, metrics, content-addressed artifact registration and digest-checked local inference exist; features, distributed training, MLflow interoperability, promotion, batch jobs and serving remain incomplete. Executable-pickle hardening is open work, not landed source truth.

Provider-neutral runtime contracts, bounded OpenAI-compatible execution, SQLite vector retrieval, RAG execution and bounded declared-tool agent loop exist; production vector backends, richer provider APIs, evaluation and distributed execution remain incomplete.

Canonical semantic model/metric/dashboard contracts, safe SQL compilation, semantic query execution and dashboard tile execution exist; persistence/catalog registration, joins/time grains/advanced semantics and Web Studio rendering remain incomplete.

Source/sink/checkpoint contracts, SQLite checkpoint CAS, sink-before-checkpoint micro-batch execution, replay-safe Parquet sink and optional Kafka JSON source exist; windows/watermarks/stateful aggregation, broader sinks, scheduler bridge and UI remain incomplete.

Normalized metrics/events, SQLite telemetry, alert rule/state engine, notification intents, usage/rate-card/cost/budget policy evaluation and actual-vs-estimate provenance exist; exporters, notification adapters, forecasting/anomaly detection, enforcement and public surfaces remain incomplete.

Stable user/service principals, groups/memberships, workspace roles, deny-by-default RBAC, actor context, OIDC JWT validation and authorization-to-append-only-audit bridge exist in merged source; public HTTP/CLI adoption, admin provisioning, PostgreSQL identity/audit persistence, network discovery and broader instrumentation remain incomplete. RBAC hardening is open work, not landed source truth.

Local/container/Compose foundation and PostgreSQL workspace/project/environment/connection/catalog metadata adapter exist; shared job/scheduler/security stores, object storage, Kubernetes/Helm, backup/restore and HA qualification remain incomplete.

Deterministic verified archive IO, project/connection round-trips, atomic multi-object project+connection commit, selected catalog subgraph round-trip and workflow+schedules portability exist; quality/ontology/ML/GenAI/data/semantic assets, PostgreSQL commit adapters, certification and public surfaces remain incomplete.

GitHub Actions remain disabled, main is unprotected, current exact-head automated qualification is absent, and release/security/legal evidence still requires blocked or human-owned work.

human_decisions.summary: Runtime capability namespace, value semantics and ambiguity policy.
Language-neutral runner protocol family and compatibility semantics.
Select and verify a real private vulnerability-reporting route.
License/NOTICE/attribution conclusions and release approval remain human review decisions.

open_work_not_landed.summary: OIDC HTTP/CLI/server-profile integration and follow-up security administration; related PRs remain open.
Replace executable ML pickle artifacts with canonical non-executable data.

next_critical_path: Keep construction/status docs synchronized with merged repository truth and never count open PRs as landed.
Convert existing domain/runtime capabilities into supported application services and public APIs, beginning with workspace/project/security, scheduler and executable data/AI paths.

Complete the multi-user server profile: store-authoritative RBAC, OIDC HTTP/CLI adoption, admin provisioning, shared PostgreSQL identity/audit persistence, broader audit instrumentation and production secret boundaries.
Expand the Public v1 API and build Web Studio against documented/generated clients.
Finish connector incrementality/CDC, lakehouse lifecycle/interoperability, scheduler branching/notifications/operator breadth and PostgreSQL HA semantics.
Extend native Bundle coverage to quality/ontology/ML/GenAI/data/semantic families and add PostgreSQL commit adapters plus certification evidence.
Complete ontology/KG actions/query and RQL, then close advanced ML/GenAI/semantic/streaming/observability gaps already exposed by the first executable runtimes.
Add an S3-compatible artifact/object-store profile and Kubernetes/Helm only after shared metadata/security/job/scheduler semantics are real.
Build and certify four vendor migration profiles only against executable canonical target capabilities with exhaustive reports.
Restore exact-head CI/release qualification only with maintainer authorization; do not claim release readiness before it exists.
